beats.headline: The door behind the club
beats.text: He comes in asking for me by name, and not for a dance, and he has the spiderweb on his elbow that says he is entitled to ask. So I take him to a private cubicle, and out the back of the cubicle, to the entrance nobody advertises. On his way out I tell him to limp, or I take out his knee. Let the room think it knows what happened in that cubicle.

beats.headline: Two brothers on the floor of their own club
beats.text: Carl and Samantha come through the club with the Vorpals still working behind them, and what they find is me and Anaconda flat on the floor, crying, in front of the whole room. The Vorpals take Minge in the same minute. I do not care what any of them see. Astrid is dead.

beats.headline: What the family actually is
beats.text: So the crawler gets all of it. My mother and the Night Wyrm were crawlers themselves, a long time ago, and they are our parents, mine and Anaconda's. She spent years pulling strings so the two of us would be dancers rather than something worse, and those strings are gone now. Hire every dancer out of the Penis Parade as mercenaries. All of them. Today. Then they keep breathing. My brother and I have somewhere else to be, and it is wherever our father is.
